formalization_refs.target: Coprime quadratic-twist sign predicate, exhaustive two-sign partition, and exact within-cohort Gram/covariance and cross-cohort Gram-contrast identities.

identity_kernel.mathematical_definition: For fundamental discriminants d with 1<|d|<=X and gcd(d,11)=1, partition by the imported theorem epsilon_d=sign(d)*(d/11), then evaluate in each sign cohort the exact finite raw Gram matrix and centered covariance of chi_d(p), their exact off-diagonal Gram contrast Delta_X=G_{X,+}-G_{X,-}, and the exact rational/multiquadratic coordinates of the 11.a2 unitary prime sum at the 13 good primes p<=43.
normalization_requirements: Use Conrey's unitary weight-2 completion with center 1/2 and twist level 11*d^2.
Restrict to fundamental d coprime to 11 and set epsilon_d=sign(d)*(d/11).
Keep ROOT_NUMBER_PLUS and ROOT_NUMBER_MINUS as separate uniform finite measures.
Omit p=11 and reuse the exact rational/multiquadratic covariance summarizer at the 13 good primes p<=43.
Derive Delta_X(p,r)=G_{X,+}(p,r)-G_{X,-}(p,r) only from aligned raw Gram entries for the 78 pairs p<r.

invariances.statement: On the coprime domain, sign(d)*(d/11) is exactly +1 or -1, so the sign cohorts are disjoint and exhaustive.
Each cohort raw matrix is an exact finite Gram matrix.
Each cohort centered matrix is an exact centered-scatter covariance.
Each cohort moment has exact rational and squarefree-radical coordinates reconstructible from the emitted aligned sufficient statistics.
Each Delta_X entry, maximum absolute contrast, and 78-pair mean square is an exact rational derived from the two aligned emitted Gram matrices.
